entrance.name: Entrance Chamber
entrance.description: A dusty stone chamber. Hieroglyphs cover the walls. A stone altar dominates the center — a scarab-shaped indentation carved into its surface. A sealed passage leads east.

east.locked_message: The eastern passage is sealed by a heavy stone slab.

main_chamber.name: Burial Chamber
main_chamber.description: The main burial chamber. A stone sarcophagus rests in the center, its lid ajar. A heavy iron door stands to the north. Dust motes float in the dim light filtering from the entrance behind you.

north.locked_message: The iron door is locked. A large keyhole sits beneath the handle.

treasure_room.name: Treasure Room
treasure_room.description: A breathtaking chamber filled with ancient riches — gold vessels, jewelled ornaments, painted urns. In the center, on a plinth, rests an ancient crown. A shaft of light falls from a crack in the ceiling above, illuminating a rope ladder that reaches the surface.

golden_scarab.name: golden scarab
golden_scarab.description: A gleaming golden beetle, perfectly preserved. Its underside has a small peg that looks like it fits into something precise.

stone_tablet.name: stone tablet
stone_tablet.description: An inscribed tablet propped against the altar. The text reads: 'Place the sacred scarab upon the altar to open the way.'

bronze_key.name: bronze key
bronze_key.description: A heavy key fashioned from aged bronze. It was resting inside the open sarcophagus.

oil_lamp.name: oil lamp
oil_lamp.description: A clay oil lamp, long since burned dry.

ancient_crown.name: ancient crown
ancient_crown.description: A magnificent crown set with lapis lazuli and carnelian. It radiates quiet authority across the millennia.

altar_lock.success_message: The scarab clicks into the indentation with a satisfying snap. The stone slab grinds aside, revealing a passage to the east.

tomb_door.success_message: The bronze key turns stiffly in the ancient lock. The iron door swings open with a groan.
tomb_door.failure_message: The key doesn't fit this lock.

win_condition.message: You stand in the treasure room, surrounded by wonders untouched for three thousand years. You've conquered the tomb — now climb out before anyone notices.
